The company plans to announce the next CEO no later than June 30, 2027, when Farooq Kathwari’s current contract ends.
Kathwari will remain on the Board as a non-executive director until the 2027 annual meeting, when he is scheduled to step down.
Until the transition, Kathwari will continue leading management and executing Ethan Allen’s strategic priorities.
